obligations.description: Tapping a category that has no recipes shows 'U ovoj kategoriji nema recepata' in the right panel.
When the screen first opens, the right panel shows 'Izaberite kategoriju'.
Tapping a category button (e.g. 'Deserti') shows that category's name and its recipes on the right panel.

intentionalDifferences.reason: Category list and recipe detail are side-by-side columns on the web; on mobile they are shown as a single-column flow (tap category → see recipes below or on a new panel).

obligations.description: When no recipes are marked as favorite, the screen shows 'Nemate omiljenih recepata'.
With at least one favorite recipe showing as a card, tapping 'Ukloni iz omiljenih' on that card removes it from the screen and it is no longer visible.

intentionalDifferences.reason: Three-column card grid is too wide for a phone; replaced with a single-column card list. Same content is shown.

obligations.description: Tapping 'Dodaj sastojke u listu za kupovinu' shows the confirmation text 'Sastojci su dodati u listu za kupovinu'.
Tapping 'Nazad na recepte' navigates back to the recipe list screen (the '/' route).
When 'Porcije' is at 1, the 'Smanji porcije' button is disabled (not tappable / visually inactive).
Tapping 'Povećaj porcije' (or the '+' button for 'Porcije') increases the serving count and updates the ingredient amounts shown on screen.
Opening any recipe detail page shows the recipe name as a heading together with its category, time, difficulty, rating and calories.

intentionalDifferences.reason: Ingredients and steps are side by side on the web; on mobile they are shown in a single-column scrollable layout.

obligations.description: Tapping the 'Deserti' button under 'Kategorija' shows only recipes in that category and hides recipes from other categories.
Typing a string that matches no recipe name in 'Pretraga' (e.g. 'zzznema') shows 'Nema recepata za zadatu pretragu'.
Typing 'Sarma' in the 'Pretraga' field shows only recipes with 'Sarma' in the name and hides other recipes.

Tapping the favorite button (star icon) on a recipe row marks it as favorite; tapping it again removes the favorite state. Because the button has no unique text name per row, use the 'Omiljeni' nav link to verify: after tapping the star on a recipe, navigating to '/omiljeni' shows that recipe. This is covered by the recipe-list-to-favorites flow.

intentionalDifferences.reason: Ingredients tooltip appears only on mouse hover; touch screens have no hover. Full ingredients are shown on the detail screen.
Sorting only changes the order of rows; a test cannot verify order.
8-column table is too wide for a phone screen; replaced with a card or list layout.

obligations.description: Filling 'Namirnica' with 'Mleko' and tapping 'Dodaj' adds 'Mleko' to the list and it becomes visible on screen.
Filling 'Namirnica' with 'Hleb' and pressing Enter (submit) also adds 'Hleb' to the list and it becomes visible on screen.
Add 'Mleko', check 'Mleko' as bought (tapping 'Mleko' row or its checkbox), then tap 'Obriši kupljene': 'Mleko' is no longer shown on the list.
With no items in the list the screen shows 'Lista za kupovinu je prazna'.

intentionalDifferences.reason: Two-column table with checkboxes is replaced with a list layout on mobile; same data is shown.

flows.description: Open a recipe detail ('/recepti/:id'), tap 'Dodaj sastojke u listu za kupovinu', then navigate to '/kupovina': the added ingredients appear in the shopping list.
On '/kategorije', tap a category then tap a recipe link: the recipe detail page ('/recepti/:id') opens and shows that recipe's name and details.
On '/omiljeni', tap a favorite recipe's name: the recipe detail page ('/recepti/:id') opens and shows that recipe's name and details.
On the recipe list ('/'), tap the favorite star button on a recipe row; then navigate to '/omiljeni': the recipe appears as a card in the favorites list.
On '/', tap a recipe name link: the recipe detail page ('/recepti/:id') opens and shows that recipe's name and details.
